---
title: "How far does it glide from a standing throw with the cosmetics removed?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 90.0
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0
PROBE_POOL = 160.0
PROBE_SPENT = 0.0

import aerosandbox as asb

plane = get_airplane()
mass, cg = get_mass_properties(plane)
weight = mass * 9.81

opti = asb.Opti()
alpha = opti.variable(init_guess=6.0, lower_bound=-5.0, upper_bound=15.0)
velocity = opti.variable(init_guess=5.0, lower_bound=1.0, upper_bound=20.0)

op_point = asb.OperatingPoint(
    velocity=velocity,
    alpha=alpha
)

aero = asb.AeroBuildup(
    airplane=plane,
    op_point=op_point
).run()

opti.subject_to(aero["L"] == weight)
opti.minimize(aero["D"])

sol = opti.solve(verbose=False, max_iter=200)
max_LD = sol.value(aero["L"]) / sol.value(aero["D"])

launch_height = 1.5
glide_distance = launch_height * max_LD
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{glide_distance:.1f} m"`]{.hero-value}
[glide distance from shoulder height]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** With the cosmetic components removed, the lighter and cleaner airframe reaches a maximum lift-to-drag ratio of [`{python} f"{max_LD:.2f}"`]{.key}. Launched from the same [`{python} f"{launch_height:.1f}"`]{.key} m height, it glides approximately [`{python} f"{glide_distance:.1f}"`]{.key} meters.
